Pickup's voice: third-party components (all run on this device; nothing is downloaded)

kokoro.web.js is the prebuilt browser bundle from kokoro-js 1.2.1 (built by scripts/build-voice.sh). It contains:
- kokoro-js 1.2.1                 Apache-2.0   https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro          (KOKORO-JS-LICENSE.txt)
- @huggingface/transformers 3.5.1 Apache-2.0   https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js (TRANSFORMERS-JS-LICENSE.txt)
- onnxruntime-web 1.21.0          MIT          https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
- phonemizer 1.2.1                Apache-2.0   https://github.com/xenova/phonemizer
  which includes espeak-ng compiled to WebAssembly: GPL-3.0-or-later, https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
  (source code: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng/releases)
ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.{wasm,mjs}: onnxruntime-web 1.21.0, MIT.

../model/: Kokoro-82M v1.0 (Apache-2.0, hexgrad), ONNX int8 export by onnx-community; voice af_heart only.
Sources and SHA-256: src/voice/model/SOURCE.md in the repository.
